name: Women's fashion online store: launch plan and first-year costs
about: Launching an online store with women's clothing, promoted on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest, with own product photography: a hired model, a make-up artist and a home studio with bought photo equipment. Four phases: Analysis, Implementation, a 3-month launch period with a bigger launch promotion and higher costs, and operation for months 4-12. Staff: the owner plus a part-time packer / customer service assistant, about $1,800 a month. Prices in US dollars. days = the owner's or team's project work in man-days (the editor turns it into labor cost as days x rate); capex = fixed assets bought (equipment, furniture, hardware); opex = operating outlays (rent, wages, stock, platform fees, marketing). Costs only: no revenue, and no ongoing stock reorders, payment fees or shipping costs, since they depend on sales.
